footnotes.note: Note: Figures in parentheses are based on 25-49 unweighted cases. 1 Includes advice or treatment from the following sources: public medical sector, private medical sector, NGO medical sector, FBO medical sector, shop, market, and itinerant drug seller. Excludes advice or treatment from a traditional practitioner. 2 No education includes informal education (e.g., madrassa/duksi/adult education). More than secondary includes middle-level colleges and universities. Secondary includes respondents who reported vocational training as their highest level of education attended, as well as respondents who reported junior school as their highest level
